info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Mortgage Loans Apply-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of mortgage loan applications in a batch process. Designed for financial institutions and mortgage brokers, it allows users to efficiently apply for multiple loans simultaneously. The endpoint manages application details, enabling the inclusion of necessary documentation and personal information for each loan request. Use cases include bulk application processing and improving operational efficiency in loan management workflows.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit their loan application along with required details. Upon successful submission, users will receive a confirmation and further instructions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a loan application. Ensure all required fields are included and properly formatted.

200.description: The loan application was processed successfully.
